title: Valorization of polyoxymethylene (POM) waste as a C1 synthon for industrially relevant dialkoxymethanes and cyclic aminals
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,1114-1121
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00547C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Matthew J. Cullen, Matthew G. Davidson, Matthew D. Jones, Jack A. Stewart
Two novel methods of upcycling waste polyoxymethylene (POM) are reported, generating dialkoxymethanes by alcoholysis and cyclic aminals by aminolysis. Mixed plastic depolymerizations containing POM were also investigated.
